Jordan — FYI, if you’re on US time that week, 09:00 CEST lands very early on your side. Do you have a travel blackout window?

Lars — would you be able to do either: 14:00 CEST (later same day) or Apr 16 morning CEST? If neither works, we can propose two options and record the session.

Thanks,

Team — looping you in to pick the best slate before I reply to Lars. Key constraints:
- Jordan is in-transit Apr 14–16 (flight lands Apr 15 late morning US PT), so early EU slots may be rough for him.
- Karthik will need to present the perf slides and run the short live session; he is available Apr 15 14:00–15:00 CEST and Apr 16 09:00–10:30 CEST.
- Northbridge asked for a 45-minute demo (platform, perf, short Q&A).

Proposed options to offer Lars (we should give two):
1) Thu Apr 15, 14:00 CEST — Jordan can join remote after flight if we keep it afternoon EU time (good for Lars).
2) Fri Apr 16, 09:30 CEST — earlier for Karthik and avoids late travel for Jordan but may be a tight start for Lars.

Please confirm availability. I attached the architecture diagram we'll reference (architecture-diagram.pdf). If we pick Apr 15 14:00, I'll update the invite and call recording option.

Thanks — Grace
